affinity.notes: Prismatic palette suggests broad fey magic rather than one dominant element.

anatomy.notes: Slender humanoid body, crown, and four wings read cleanly despite dense ornament.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "aerial support-controller" does not semantically communicate Four-Season Sovereign (Sovereign) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Exposed central body and oversized wings clearly signal a fragile airborne controller.

finish.notes: Highly resolved materials, wing veining, and facial focal detail.

framing.notes: Centered full-body silhouette with wings comfortably contained in frame.

identity.notes: Blind perception "butterfly-winged fey queen" semantically identifies fae/fae-fae-monarch.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "high" is accepted for intended T5 under the documented v2 normalization.
